name: Power Distribution (PDM, fuses, breakers)
description: Solid-state Power Distribution Module replacing the factory underhood (X50A) and rear (X51) fuse/relay blocks, plus its power feed, connectors, mounting, a small always-hot fused block for life-support/timing circuits allowed to bypass the master switch where rules permit, and resettable circuit breakers.

components.name: Power Distribution Module (PDM)
components.description: Programmable solid-state switching module that replaces fuses and relays. Each output has current limiting, retry logic, and logs current/voltage over CAN to the dash/logger. Typical channel plan on this car: ECU main, ignition coils, injectors/DI driver, fuel pumps (2 x PWM), radiator fan (PWM), intercooler pump, starter, dash/logger, keypad, ABS, alternator L-terminal, rain light, brake lights, headlights, wipers, radio, camera, cool-suit, transponder (if not always-hot), data sensors 12 V.
components.location: Passenger side under/behind the dash on a vibration-isolated aluminum panel (x≈1.05, y≈0.55, z≈-0.40), close to the ECU and the firewall bulkhead.

factory.name: GM underhood fuse block (X50A) + rear fuse block (X51) + BCM-switched relays
factory.notes: Factory blocks are tied to the BCM/body harness; with a standalone ECU and stripped body harness they are removed.

raceOptions.name: MoTeC PDM30
raceOptions.notes: 8 x 20 A + 22 x 8 A outputs (115 A / 60 A transient), 16 switch inputs, 1 CAN, M6 battery stud, 34 + 26 pin connectors, 270–300 g. Config via PDM Manager + UTC #61059.

raceOptions.name: AiM PDM32
raceOptions.notes: 28 high-side outputs (4 x 20 A, 12 x 15 A, 12 x 10 A) + 4 x 35 A half-bridge, 120 A total, 14 inputs, 3 CAN + LIN; built-in logger/dash controller with 6 or 10 in display.

raceOptions.name: ECUMaster PMU16
raceOptions.notes: 10 x 25 A + 6 x 15 A, 150 A total, 16 analog inputs, 2 CAN, wiper H-bridge, IMU; DL version logs 256 MB. Strong value option.

raceOptions.name: Cartek Power Distribution Panel PDP-16
raceOptions.notes: 16 outputs with built-in push-button panel (no laptop needed), 5/10/15 A selectable, 160 A total, 16 ECU inputs, wiper module, AMPSEAL connectors. No CAN keypad needed.

hardware.spec: M6 x 1.0 nut + spring washer on ring lug
hardware.notes: MoTeC specifies an M6 stud; torque value not found – do not over-torque the PCB-mounted stud. Support the cable with a P-clamp so its weight is not on the stud.

hardware.spec: M5 screws through rubber isolators into rivnuts
M5 rubber bobbin isolators (~30 Shore A–50 Shore A)

installNotes: Write the load list with continuous/inrush currents first; assign 20 A channels to fans, pumps, starter and ignition; pair outputs where current exceeds a channel rating.
Mount the PDM within ~1 m of the battery-feed junction with the main cable fused.
Program soft-start/PWM for fan and fuel pumps; program retries (e.g. 3) except for the starter.
Program logic: engine-kill input from isolator → all engine outputs off; rain light ON with headlights or keypad; brake lights from brake-pressure channel via CAN.
Log every output current; set warning thresholds on the dash.
inspection: Review PDM fault/trip log after each session.

components.name: Auxiliary fused block (always-hot / life-support circuits)
components.description: Small sealed fuse block for circuits that rules allow to remain powered with the master switch OFF (NASA CCR wording allows radio, onboard fire system and life-support/medical devices), plus key-off memory feeds (logger RTC, transponder if direct-powered). Fed from the battery side of the isolator through its own fuse. Fire-suppression systems normally have their own battery.
components.location: Trunk near battery or passenger footwell.

raceOptions.name: Blue Sea Systems ST Blade 4–6 circuit sealed fuse block

specs.Circuits: radio 5 A, transponder 2.5 A (per MyLaps TR2 guide), fire-system 5 A, logger memory 2 A

installNotes: Confirm with your series rulebook what may bypass the master switch; SCCA wording is stricter (all circuits except fire system).
